# mcrl auth

[Command reference](README.md)

Manage API keys and profiles.

```text
Manage API keys and profiles.

A profile is the connection setting for one Mackerel organization. The API
key is looked up in this order:

  1. the MACKEREL_APIKEY environment variable
  2. the profile's api_key_command in the config file
  3. the OS keychain (stored by "mcrl auth login")
  4. the profile's plaintext api_key in the config file
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`auth list`](#mcrl-auth-list) | List profiles in the config file |
| [`auth login`](#mcrl-auth-login) | Store an API key for a profile |
| [`auth logout`](#mcrl-auth-logout) | Remove the stored API key of a profile |
| [`auth status`](#mcrl-auth-status) | Show the active profile, where its API key comes from, and its organization |
| [`auth switch`](#mcrl-auth-switch) | Set the default profile |
| [`auth token`](#mcrl-auth-token) | Print the API key of the active profile |

## mcrl auth list

List profiles in the config file.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl auth list
```

## mcrl auth login

Store an API key for a profile.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl auth login [flags]

Store an API key for a profile.

The key is verified with GET /api/v0/org and saved in the OS keychain. Where
no keychain is available, --insecure-storage saves it in plaintext in the
config file instead (file mode 0600).

Examples:
  # Paste the key at the prompt
  mcrl auth login

  # Read the key from stdin, for a second organization on Mackerel for KCPS
  op read op://Infra/mackerel/credential | mcrl auth login --profile kcps --with-token --base-url https://kcps-mackerel.io

Flags:
      --base-url string                 API base URL to save in the profile (e.g. https://kcps-mackerel.io)
      --insecure-storage[=true|false]   store the key in plaintext in the config file
      --with-token[=true|false]         read the API key from stdin
```

## mcrl auth logout

Remove the stored API key of a profile.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl auth logout
```

## mcrl auth status

Show the active profile, where its API key comes from, and its organization.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl auth status
```

## mcrl auth switch

Set the default profile.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl auth switch <profile>
```

## mcrl auth token

Print the API key of the active profile.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl auth token

Print the API key of the active profile as plain text, for passing it to
other tools. Avoid running it where the output is visible to others.
```
